assumptions: Independent simulated capital; no contest-account ownership.
Flat entries quote both sides only when combined spread covers modeled fees and required edge; partial fills remain inventory risk.
Touch fills conditionally attribute observed volume to our side after visible queue exhaustion; aggressor direction and true FIFO priority are unverified.
Cancel acknowledgment does not release unresolved funding; complete window and post-end checkpoint are required.
Opposite BUY FIFO netting models the documented engine credit of one per netted share; all modeled fills remain counterfactual.
Aged inventory all-or-none simulations require later fresh depth after modeled latency; payout uses the limit-price lower bound and no capacity is reused at the same side/engine sequence.

limitations: Retrospective sensitivity analysis, not untouched holdout or observed exchange fills.
Six independent paper banks; gains are not summed and original bank is unchanged.
Participation scenarios are assumptions; full participation cannot certify queue priority or market impact.
All original receipt/processing/execution clocks, coverage gaps, observed depth, write pacing and exact funded accounting are preserved.
Same captured entry scopes as original episodes; no hindsight universe selection.
Peak committed metric samples episode ends, not every intermediate event.
Fresh liquidation marks must be read with their timestamps; missing terminal depth remains null.
